<title level="1" right="Creature Family">[Dragon, Adamantine](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=396)</title>

**Source** [Monster Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=221) pg. 108

The powerful adamantine dragons are one of several dragons known as skymetal dragons. The innate magic that flows through these dragons causes them to draw particular metals to their bodies like magnets or, in some cases, naturally grow these skymetals on their bodies. Adamantine dragons begin their lives with tough scales that are naturally replaced with thicker and even tougher [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2915) plating as they grow older. Adamantine dragons are typically steadfast and loyal. Once they commit to a certain purpose, changing their minds is nigh impossible. 

<title level="2">Members</title>
[Adult Adamantine Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2933) (Creature 13), [Ancient Adamantine Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2934) (Creature 18), [Young Adamantine Dragon](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2932) (Creature 9)

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_3_Locations.png">Adamantine Dragon Lairs</title>

Adamantine dragons live primarily in mountains, canyons, and other rocky terrain. Reaching their lairs can be difficult, as an adamantine dragon usually digs from wherever they are to reach their lair. This creates vast networks of tunnels that can be confusing. The hoard of an adamantine dragon is generally littered with gemstones and precious metals they find during their digs. As such, adamantine dragons generally prefer other gifts, with many adamantine dragons being fond of interesting tales and memorable songs over more material possessions
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="">Adamantine Dragon Spellcasters</title>

Adamantine dragon spellcasters tend to cast the following spells. 

### Young Adamantine Dragon
 **Primal Prepared Spells** DC 28, attack +21; **4th** [_shape stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1667), [_unfettered movement_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1732); **3rd** [_earthbind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1506), [_one with stone_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1619), [_slow_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1677); **2nd** [_darkness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1480), [_shatter_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1670), [_water walk_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1756); **1st** [_air bubble_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1438), [_tailwind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1711), [_vanishing tracks_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1737); **Cantrips (4th)** [_caustic blast_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1461), [_detect magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1485), [_know the way_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1582), [_sigil_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1673), [_tangle vine_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1713) 

### Adult Adamantine Dragon
 **Primal Prepared Spells** DC 34, attack +27; As young adamantine dragon, plus **6th** [_petrify_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1628), [_tangling creepers_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1714); **5th** [_impaling spike_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1571), [_magic passage_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1591), [_speak with stones_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1682); **4th** vapor form; **Cantrips (6th)** _caustic blast_, _detect magic_, _know the way_, _sigil_, _tangle vine_ 

### Ancient Adamantine Dragon
 **Primal Prepared Spells** DC 41, attack +36; As adult adamantine dragon, plus **8th** [_earthquake_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1507), [_desiccate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1484), [_moment of renewal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1607); **7th** [_mask of terror_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1595), [_regenerate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1648), [_volcanic eruption_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1746); **6th** [_field of life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1526); **Cantrips (8th)** _caustic blast_, _detect magic_, _know the way_, _sigil_, _tangle vine_
</aside>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar_4_RelatedCreatures.png">Trivorrin</title>

The adamantine dragon Trivorrin is a well-known threat to the wandering groups of Numeria. Residing in his home within the massive rift known as the First Blade's path, Trivorrin acts as a sort of arbiter for the various clans and tribes of the region. Anyone who brings offerings of technological wonders from across Numeria earns safe passage and protection from the dragon, making his home a neutral ground for clan politics. Trivorrin has been stockpiling technology for centuries in an attempt to build a secret invention of his own.
</aside>

<title level="2" right="Creature Family Group">Dragon</title>

**Related Families**
[Dragon, Conspirator](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=397), [Dragon, Diabolic](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=398), [Dragon, Empyreal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=399), [Dragon, Fortune](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=400), [Dragon, Horned](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=401), [Dragon, Mirage](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=402), [Dragon, Omen](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=403)
